bug_info.bug_desc: In the is_inside_execute_regions function, the condition that selects between the no-rule case and the configured-rule case is inverted. When NrExecuteRegionRules is 0, the function initializes the match vector to zero and returns the OR-reduction of that empty/no-match result, denying execution even though no execute-region filter is configured. When NrExecuteRegionRules is non-zero, it bypasses the configured range checks and returns 1 unconditionally, allowing instruction fetches regardless of the configured executable regions.
bug_info.fix_hint: Make the configured-rule path execute only when NrExecuteRegionRules is non-zero. In that case, evaluate the configured execute-region range checks and return whether any rule matches. When NrExecuteRegionRules is zero, return 1 to indicate that execute-region filtering is not restricting instruction fetches.
